title: Candidate dash — morning/afternoon checklist
content:
MORNING TRIAGE (quick)
- 08:30 PT: skim inbox + calendar for clashes (flag anything with >1 reschedule)
- Today focus: 3rd-round slate + two take-home submissions to grade

CANDIDATE PRIORITIES (top of day)
1) Eva Morales — take-home submission due EOD today (reminder email 10:00 PT)
   - Interviewers: Anu (ENG), Julian (PM). Confirmed window next Tue 9am PT.
   - Action: ping Anu to confirm rubric (quick checklist) — Slack DM: @anu please confirm lens for eva take-home by 11am.
2) Marcus Lee — loop back on CS feedback from onsite (on hold: engineering feedback delayed)
   - Blocker: PR review backlog for Marcus' panelists (notify SRE leads)
3) Priyanka Rao — scheduling follow-up for 2nd-round behavioral (candidate in IST)
   - Timezone calc: candidate IST 10:00 = 22:30 PT (ouch) — propose 9:00 IST / 20:30 PT or next-morning slots.

AFTERNOON PUSH (timed tasks)
- 12:30 PT: send reminder to Eva (template below)
- 13:30 PT: update hiring sheet with morning notes (sheet link pinned in Slack)
- 14:00 PT: calendar rescue — fix double-book for Julian (swap panels)
- 15:00 PT: batch reschedule window for candidates requesting changes (send alt options)
- 16:45 PT: run final sanity check on tomorrow's panel schedules + confirm Zoom links

TEMPLATES / QUICK MESSAGES
- Reminder for take-home:
  Subject: Friendly reminder — take-home due today
  Hi Eva — quick nudge that your take-home is due EOD today. If you need extra time, reply and we can extend by up to 48 hours. Looking forward to reviewing. — Kai

- Reschedule options (short):
  Hi Marcus — sorry for the back-and-forth. Here are 3 alternate times: Tue 9am PT / Tue 1pm PT / Wed 10am PT. Which works?

- No-show follow-up (1 hour after):
  Hi [Name], we missed you for the interview scheduled at [time]. Are you okay? If you'd like to reschedule, share a few times and we’ll sort it out.

PIPELINE SNAPSHOT (notes to self)
- ENG IC (sourcing) — 5 active; 2 take-homes this week
- PM — 3 onsite this next week; prioritize cross-functional panel availability
- SRE — backlog of feedback from on-site (Jen + Tomas delayed)

BLOCKERS / THINGS TO ESCALATE
- Panelist bandwidth: Julian and Jen have overlapping interviews (ask product to drop non-critical 1:1)
- Hiring doc HIRE-378 missing final scorecard details (ticket commented; need owner)

NOTES TO SELF (scratch-style)
- When candidate in GMT/BST: default propose 10:30 or 14:00 PT windows (works for EMEA mornings)
- Keep 1:30–2:30 PT clear as buffer for urgent reschedules
- Use "+1 day" rule for follow-ups: if no reply to scheduling proposal after 24h, ping again; after 72h mark regen as stale

END-OF-DAY WRAP (checklist)
- mark interview outcomes in Greenhouse (or update hiring sheet if GH pending)
- confirm next-day panels + send confirmation messages to candidates + interviewers
- log any blocker threads into #recruiting-escalations with TL;DR

RANDOM SCRATCH (ideas / followups)
- Draft a short "reschedule etiquette" line for candidate emails (set expectations)
- Propose internal doc: "Panelist quick rubric" — 1 pager for quick consistent feedback (ping product leads for buy-in)

TODAY'S QUICK TIMELINE (my calendar)
- 08:30 PT inbox triage
- 09:30 PT 15-min sync with Priya (standup)
- 10:00 PT send Eva reminder
- 12:30 PT update sheet
- 14:00 PT calendar fixes
- 15:00 PT batch reschedule
- 16:45 PT confirm tomorrow panels
- 17:30 PT DOE wrap and log

KEEP/MUST REMEMBER
- Always include timezone in first line when proposing times (candidate timezone -> candidate local + PT equivalence)
- If a candidate requests to move past 72h, check for active offer timelines before extending

END
